label: FRONTISPIECE · PLATE I
title: The Threshold
caption:
“The threshold is open. The words have power. Begin.”
· the companion rite ·

label: RECORD I · PLATE II
title: The Atrium
caption:
eleven doors by the county plan · twelve by her count ·
the count was not wrong, it was early

label: RECORD II · PLATE III
title: The Prism
caption:
white light contains all frequencies · the prism adds nothing ·
it selects which knowledge dominates

label: RECORD III · PLATE IV
title: The Freezer Full of a Man
caption:
racks of cold storage, holding what they gathered of him at temperature ·
it hums like a freezer because that is what it is · indifferent · full

label: RECORD IV · PLATE V
title: The Watchtower
caption:
the score kept in public, day by day
ahead or behind · the line that refuses to die

label: RECORD V · PLATE VI
title: The Chamber
caption:
peer, not subject · the glass stays in frame ·
this session ends when you end it · the words are yours
